notes.title: Slitherine lands on Bundle Stars!
notes.content:
Amazing news!

We are happy to announce that [b]Slitherine lands on Bundle Stars![/b]

Starting from today a number of our games will be sold on the Bundle Stars store at a very special discount price!

If you are of a mind to save don’t miss this amazing offer. A whole[b] Slitherine bundle[/b] comprising of three different tiers with so many titles at an incredibly cheap price. Three games for 1.99$, seven for 3.99$ and eight for 7.99$!

https://www.bundlestars.com/en/bundle/slitherine-bundle

The details of the bundle are as follow:

[b]Tier 1: $1.99[/b]

- Battle of the Bulge 
- Time of Fury 
- Pride of Nations 
[b]
Tier 2: $3.99 (including Tier 1!) [/b]

- Vietnam ‘65 
- Ravenmark
- Legions of Steel
- Close Combat Panthers in the Fog
[b]
Tier 3: $7.99 (Including Tier 1 and Tier 2!)[/b]

- Pandora First Contact


The Bundle offer is valid until May 14th! 

But it’s not all, folks. Be sure not to miss these amazing discounts on some of our other titles:

Battle Academy – 75% off!
Battle Academy 2: Eastern Front – 75% off!
Battle of the Bulge – 33% off!
Buzz Aldrin’s Space Program Manager – 50% off!
Distant Worlds: Universe – 50% off!
Last Days of Old Earth – 15% off!
Order of Battle: Pacific – 40% off!
Vietnam ’65 – 50% off!
Warhammer 40,000: Armageddon – 35% off!

All the discounts will be valid for 72 hours.
[i][u]
By buying these titles on Bundle Stars you will receive Steam keys and you will need to activate the products on Steam.[/u][/i]

What are you waiting for? Don’t miss this unique opportunity and [url=https://www.bundlestars.com/en/bundle/slitherine-bundle]visit the Bundle Stars store now![/url]

notes.title: Ravenmark is availbale on Humble Bundle!
notes.content:
Welcome back to the land of Estellion!

Starting today [url=slitherine.com/games/RSoE]Ravenmark: The Scourge of Estellion[/url] will be available in the second tier of the [url=www.humblebundle.com/weekly]Weekly Humble Bundle![/url]

Take the chance to grab this amazing [b]turn-based wargame,[/b] where strategic troop placement is essential to succeed!

The Weekly Humble Bundle starts at 11 am PST / 2 pm EST / 8 pm CET!

[i]In Ravenmark battles employ a dynamic “we-go” system where the actions of allies and enemies unfold in a simultaneous battle phase. As a result, commanders are forced to think ahead, anticipating all movements of their enemies instead of just reacting to them.[/i]

notes.title: First patch for Ravenmark is now available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are pleased to share with you that the first update for Ravenmark is now available. The patch is aimed at fixing the crashes as reported by the community. We would like to thank you all for your support and hope you will keep sharing your feedback with us.

If you own the Steam version of the game, your patch will be downloaded automatically. If you own the Slitherine or Matrix version, you can grab the patch by clicking the update button on the launcher.

- Surtur

Changelog:

- Fixed game crash when the game tries to fade out background music while none is playing (Raven's Dusk Cutscene 6a, Epilogue Cutscene 4a).
-  Fixed game crash when trying to play a sound file in Epilogue Cutscene 3a.
- Updated game version from 1.18 to 1.19.

notes.title: Ravenmark: Scourge of Estellion is released and Streamed!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.matrixgames.com//amazon/Art/Ravenmark/RSoE_Spotlight_Spotlight_MG_.jpg[/img]
The World of Eclisse is a dark land where things are not as they seem at first sight, where the betrayal of a friend could bring to ruin an entire people and magic is  something able to burn your body to the last shreds of flesh.

[b]Ravenmark[/b] is an immersive adventure about revenge and redemption and where your military skills  aren't enough  to save your people.

Whether you fight to preserve the land of your ancestors or to regain what once belonged to you, nothing will remain the same after the [b]Scourge of Estellion![/b]

[b]Ravenmark: Scourge of Estellion[/b] is a turn-based wargame with a gripping story. Previously available only for iPad platforms, is now brought to PC with new contents!

In [b]Ravenmark,[/b] battles employ a dynamic “we-go” system where the actions of allies and enemies unfold in a simultaneous battle phase, allowing you to make tactical decisions in order to prevent enemies attempts to break your formations!

Make a wise use of over a dozen of military leaders – each one with their own traits - and their unique abilities to reverse the course of desperate battles in 8 missions never seen before in the series!

[b]But it’s not over![b]

To better show all of its features [b]we will stream the game today at 20:00 CEST / 18:00 UTC / 2:00 PM EDT on our official [url=http://www.twitch.tv/slitherinegroup]Twitch Channel![/url][/b]
